description: Ultra bright smart LED NeoPixels arranged in a circle. The rings are chainable - connect the output pin of one to the input pin of another. Use only one microcontroller pin to control as many as you can chain together. Each LED is addressable as the driver chip is inside the LED. Each one has ~18mA constant current drive so the color will be very consistent even if the voltage varies, and no external choke resistors are required making the design slim. Power the whole thing with 5VDC (4-7V works). Single data line with a timing-specific protocol requiring a real-time microcontroller such as an AVR, Arduino, etc.

Bosch BNO055 smart 9-DOF sensor that does sensor fusion on-chip. Takes a MEMS accelerometer, magnetometer and gyroscope on a single die with a high speed ARM Cortex-M0 based processor to digest all the sensor data, abstract the sensor fusion and real time requirements away, and output data in quaternions, Euler angles or vectors. Includes SparkFun qwiic compatible STEMMA QT connectors for I2C. Rather than spending weeks fiddling with algorithms, you can have meaningful sensor data in minutes thanks to the BNO055.

INA219B chip measures both high side voltage and DC current draw over I2C with 1% precision. Handles high side current measuring up to +26VDC, even though powered with 3 or 5V. Also reports high side voltage for tracking battery life or solar panels. Precision amplifier measures voltage across 0.1 ohm 1% sense resistor. With internal 12 bit ADC, resolution at +/-3.2A range is 0.8mA. With internal gain at minimum div8, max current is +/-400mA with 0.1mA resolution. Advanced users can replace the sense resistor to change the range.

Bosch BME280 environmental sensor with temperature, barometric pressure and humidity. Best low-cost sensing solution for measuring humidity with +/-3% accuracy, barometric pressure with +/-1 hPa absolute accuracy, and temperature with +/-1.0C accuracy. Can also be used as an altimeter with +/-1 meter or better accuracy. Next-generation upgrade to BMP085/BMP180/BMP183 with low altitude noise of 0.25m and fast conversion time. Supports both I2C and SPI interfaces.

I2C digital temperature sensor with typical accuracy of +/-0.25C over -40C to +125C range and precision of +0.0625C. Works with any microcontroller using standard I2C. 3 address pins allow up to 8 on a single I2C bus without address collisions. Wide voltage range 2.7V to 5.5V logic. Placed on a breakout board PCB with mounting holes and pull down resistors for address pins.

ATSAMD21G18 ARM Cortex M0 processor clocked at 48 MHz at 3.3V logic (same as Arduino Zero). 256K of FLASH and 32K of RAM. Built-in USB for USB-to-Serial program and debug capability with no need for an FTDI-like chip. Connector for 3.7V Lithium polymer batteries with built-in battery charging. Automatically switches between USB and battery power. Battery voltage divider on analog pin for monitoring. Feather form factor for portable projects.

Upgraded motor shield using TB6612 MOSFET drivers with 1.2A per channel (3A peak for ~20ms). Much lower voltage drops than the original L293D darlington design, with built-in flyback diodes. Fully-dedicated PWM driver chip handles all motor and speed controls over I2C, requiring only SDA and SCL pins. Drives up to 4 DC motors or 2 stepper motors. Completely stackable: 5 address-select pins means up to 32 shields (64 steppers or 128 DC motors). Polarity protection FET on power pins and prototyping area included.

VLSI VS1053B DSP codec chip breakout. Decodes MP3, AAC, Ogg Vorbis, WMA, MIDI, FLAC, WAV (PCM and ADPCM). Can also record audio in PCM (WAV) and compressed Ogg Vorbis. Adjustable bass, treble, and volume digitally. 8 GPIO pins for LEDs or buttons. Lightweight SPI interface so nearly any microcontroller can play audio from SD card. Special MIDI mode reads classic 31250Kbaud MIDI data on UART pin and acts like a synth/drum machine with dozens of built-in drum and sample effects.

Si5351A I2C controller clock generator with precision 25MHz crystal reference and internal PLL and dividers. Generates frequencies from <8KHz up to 150+ MHz. Three independent outputs, each with a different frequency. Outputs are 3Vpp. Breakout includes 3.3V LDO regulator for 3-5VDC power and level shifting circuitry on I2C lines for 3V or 5V logic compatibility. Optional SMA connector for RF work.

All-in-one digital audio amp that takes standard I2S digital audio input, decodes it into analog, and amplifies directly into a speaker. Combines I2S DAC and amp into one breakout. Delivers 3.2 Watts into 4 ohm speaker (5V power at 10% THD). Class D controller runs from 2.7V-5.5VDC, incredibly efficient for portable and battery-powered projects. Built-in thermal and over-current protection.

Open source PCB for the Feather RP2040 in Feather form factor. Built around the Raspberry Pi RP2040 chip. Design has been built and tested successfully. PCB format is EagleCAD schematic and board layout. Released so folks can start creating custom designs based on the RP2040 chip.

Introduction to electronics and programming board. Programmable with Microsoft MakeCode (block-based or Javascript), CircuitPython, Arduino IDE, and code.org CS Discoveries. Round board with alligator-clip pads, no soldering required. Powers from USB, AAA battery pack, or LiPoly battery. Built-in USB support - plug in to program, shows up automatically. Same shape and size as original Circuit Playground Classic but with more sensors and easier programming.

3x4 keyboard macropad powered by Raspberry Pi RP2040 with 8 MB flash. USB-C for power/data, can act as HID, MIDI, UART. 12 Cherry MX-compatible key switch sockets (individually tied to GPIO, not matrix wired) with one NeoPixel RGB LED per switch. Rotary encoder with 20 detents and push-switch. 128x64 SH1106 monochrome OLED on high speed hardware SPI. 8mm speaker/buzzer with Class D amplifier. STEMMA QT connector for I2C add-ons. Programmable with CircuitPython or Arduino. Dual core Cortex M0+ at ~130MHz with 264KB SRAM.

ESP32-S3 in Feather format with dual 240 MHz cores, WiFi and BLE support, and native USB (keyboard, disk drive, MIDI). 8 MB flash, 512KB SRAM, no PSRAM. USB-C with built-in battery charging for LiPoly. LC709203 battery monitor for voltage and state of charge reporting over I2C. STEMMA QT connector with switchable power for low power mode. Deep sleep ~100uA from LiPoly connection. Works with ESP-IDF, Arduino, or CircuitPython. Compatible with 50+ Feather Wings.

ESP32-based Feather using the official WROOM32 module with dual-core ESP32 chip, 4 MB SPI Flash, tuned antenna. Both WiFi and Bluetooth Classic/LE support. Built-in USB-to-Serial converter, automatic bootloader reset, Lithium Ion/Polymer charger. All GPIOs brought out for use with Feather Wings. Compared to ESP8266: more GPIO, plenty of analog inputs, two analog outputs, multiple extra peripherals (spare UART), two cores, higher-speed processor.

Arduino Mega form factor board with Microchip ATSAMD51P20: 120MHz Cortex M4 with floating point DSP, 1MB flash, 256KB RAM. 70 GPIO pins total, dual 1 MSPS DAC, dual 1 MSPS ADC (15 analog pins), 8x hardware SERCOM (I2C/SPI/UART), 22x PWM outputs, stereo I2S, 12-bit parallel capture controller (camera/video in), built-in AES-256 crypto, true RNG. 8 MB QSPI Flash, Micro SD card slot, NeoPixel. Power from 6-12V DC with on/off switch or micro USB. Native USB stack with UF2 bootloader. Compatible with Arduino and CircuitPython.

IoT device with ATSAMD51J20 M4 processor and ESP32 Wi-Fi coprocessor with TLS/SSL support. 3.2 inch 320x240 color TFT with resistive touch screen. Includes speaker, light sensor, temperature sensor (ADT7410), NeoPixel, microSD card slot, 8MB flash, plug-in I2C and 2 analog/digital ports. SAMD51 handles native USB (disk drive, HID, MIDI, serial) and user interface while ESP32 handles WiFi/TLS/SSL. Python-powered using tinyJSON/APIs for IoT data. Also available as PyPortal Pynt (2.4 inch smaller version, no ADT7410).

Feather nRF52840 with built-in sensor suite. Nordic nRF52840: ARM Cortex M4F at 64MHz with HW floating point, 1MB flash, 256KB SRAM, Bluetooth Low Energy. Native USB stack with UF2 bootloader. Sensors: LSM6DS33 Accel/Gyro + LIS3MDL magnetometer (9-DoF), APDS9960 proximity/light/color/gesture, PDM microphone, SHT humidity, BMP280 temperature/barometric pressure. 21 GPIO, 6x 12-bit ADC, up to 12 PWM outputs, FCC/IC/TELEC certified. Up to +8dBm output power. Works with Arduino IDE and CircuitPython with BLE support.

Arduino-compatible Metro form factor with Microchip ATSAMD51: 120MHz Cortex M4 with floating point support. Same size and shield-compatible as other Metros with analog pins, SPI/UART/I2C in standard positions. Compatible with all Arduino shields. Powered by ATSAMD51J19 processor.

Sensor-packed development board in BBC micro:bit form factor with edge-connector and 5 big pads. Nordic nRF52840: 1MB Flash, 256KB RAM, 64MHz Cortex M4. 1.3 inch 240x240 Color IPS TFT display. Powers from 3-6V battery. Sensors: LSM6DS33 Accel/Gyro + LIS3MDL magnetometer (9-DoF), APDS9960 proximity/light/color/gesture, PDM microphone, SHT humidity, BMP280 temperature/barometric pressure/altitude. RGB NeoPixel, 2MB internal flash, buzzer/speaker, two white LEDs for illumination/color sensing. STEMMA QT / Qwiic connector for I2C add-ons. Programmable with Arduino IDE or CircuitPython.

PCB for the Adafruit 12 and 16 bit I2C ADC with Programmable Gain Amplifier. The ADS1115 is a precision analog-to-digital converter with up to 16-bit resolution and programmable gain amplifier. Works with both 3.3V and 5V microcontrollers.

RGB and Clear light sensing color sensor with 3,800,000:1 dynamic range, integrated IR blocking filter for accurate color measurement, and adjustable integration time and gain. Perfect for color detection and light sensing projects.

I2C-based capacitive touch sensor with 12 independent touch pad inputs. Features built-in filtering, selectable I2C address for up to 48 pads on one bus. Includes IRQ line indicator LED. 3V-only chip with regulated power and I2C level shifting for 3-5V compatibility.

Precision barometric pressure and temperature sensor with altitude measurement capability. Offers temperature accuracy of plus or minus 1C and pressure accuracy of plus or minus 1 hPa for altitude measurement within plus or minus 1 meter. 5V-safe with integrated regulator and I2C level shifter.

Triple-axis accelerometer and magnetometer compass module on single chip. Measures gravity direction for orientation sensing and magnetic field for true north detection. I2C interface with 5V-safe logic and power, 3.3V regulator included.

Wide spectrum analog light sensor with logarithmic response. Measures ambient light levels accurately across a wide dynamic range. Simple analog interface for integration with any microcontroller ADC.

Full-featured Arduino-compatible development board built on ATmega328. Includes USB-to-serial converter, polarity-protected DC power jack, four status LEDs for debugging, and hardware SPI/I2C/UART support. Works with all Arduino shields.

Ultra-compact ATtiny85-based development board. Available in 3.3V and 5V logic versions. Arduino IDE programmable with bitbang USB support. Tiny enough to embed directly in projects with minimal cost and size penalty.

All-in-one environmental sensor from Bosch with temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and VOC gas sensing. Measures temperature to plus or minus 1C, humidity to plus or minus 3 percent, pressure to plus or minus 1 hPa. SPI and I2C interfaces with 3.3V regulator and level shifting.

Extremely accurate RTC with integrated temperature-compensated crystal oscillator. Maintains time to within 2 minutes per year. Includes battery-backed power and temperature sensor for frequency compensation. Perfect for precision timekeeping and data logging.

Precision temperature sensor amplifier for PT100 resistance temperature detectors. Supports 2, 3, or 4-wire RTD configuration with automatic wire resistance compensation. Provides laboratory-grade temperature measurement accuracy for industrial applications.

Precision thermocouple amplifier with cold junction compensation. Supports all common thermocouple types with automatic type detection. SPI interface with microcontroller for high-precision temperature measurement in harsh environments.

PWM LED driver for 16x9 LED matrices with individual brightness control. I2C interface with 8 frames of display memory for animations. Chainable design - stack up to 4 drivers for 16x36 displays. STEMMA QT connectors for solderless connections.

Hardware-accelerated TFT display controller for 40-pin parallel TFT displays up to 800x480. Includes resistive touchscreen support over same SPI interface. 768KB on-chip RAM for display buffering, hardware shape drawing, and built-in fonts.

I2C-controlled 16-channel PWM driver for servo and LED control. Up to 62 boards chainable for 992 total outputs. 12-bit resolution, adjustable frequency, open-drain or push-pull output. Reverse polarity protection and 220 ohm series resistors on outputs.

Class-D mono amplifier delivering 2.5W into 4-8 ohm speakers. 2.0-5.5V supply range with 90 percent efficiency. Volume adjustable via trimmer pot. Built-in thermal and over-current protection. Fully differential inputs for clean audio without ground issues.

Swiss-army-knife USB breakout for SPI, I2C, serial UART, JTAG protocols. Built-in GPIO pins for LED control and button reading. Direct computer-to-device communication without intermediate microcontroller. Perfect for development and debugging.

Bidirectional voltage level shifter for 4 channels. Convert between 3.3V and 5V logic levels safely. BSS138 MOSFET-based design for reliable operation. Essential for connecting 3.3V sensors to 5V microcontrollers.

CircuitPython-focused 48MHz ARM Cortex M0+ development board. 256KB Flash, 32KB RAM. Built-in USB bootloader, 2MB SPI Flash, NeoPixel LED. Battery charger for LiPo batteries. Works with entire FeatherWing ecosystem.

Fast 120MHz ARM Cortex M4 with floating-point support. 512KB Flash, 192KB RAM. Originally designed for CircuitPython but Arduino compatible. Runs code at significantly faster speeds than M0-based boards.

Ultra-small SAMD21-based board with STEMMA QT I2C connector for plug-and-play sensors. Seeed Xiao-compatible pinout. 256KB Flash, 32KB RAM. RGB NeoPixel, reset button. Optional SOIC SPI Flash on bottom pads.

Tiny RP2040 board with STEMMA QT I2C connector. Dual-core 125MHz processor, 264KB RAM, 8MB SPI Flash. RGB NeoPixel, boot and reset buttons. Same form-factor as SAMD21 QT Py. CircuitPython and MicroPython support.

Pro Micro-shaped RP2040 board for custom keyboard builds. 8MB QSPI Flash, built-in NeoPixel. STEMMA QT I2C port. Castellated pads for direct PCB mounting. 20 GPIO pins support up to 100-key matrices. CircuitPython ready.
Low-power WiFi Feather with native USB support. 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM. Built-in LiPo charger. STEMMA QT connector for sensors. Single-core 240MHz processor ideal for IoT and WiFi projects.

Nostalgic ATmega328P-based Feather at 3.3V and 8MHz. Familiar Arduino chip in Feather form factor with USB-serial converter via CP2104. Battery charging support. Compatible with entire FeatherWing ecosystem.
Fastest CircuitPython-capable Feather at 168MHz STM32F405 Cortex M4 with FPU. 1MB Flash, 192KB RAM, 2MB SPI Flash. USB-C connector, SD card socket, NeoPixel. First USB-C Feather design.

Minimal ESP32 breakout for size and cost-conscious projects. Dual-core WiFi/Bluetooth processor with 4MB SPI Flash. Requires external CP2104 or FTDI cable for programming. Perfect for battery-powered IoT applications.

ESP32-S3 Feather with integrated 240x135 IPS TFT color display. Native USB, 4MB Flash, 2MB PSRAM. PWM-controlled backlight. STEMMA QT connector. Deep sleep mode uses only 100uA. Perfect for portable GUI applications.

Latest Feather with powerful RP2350 dual-core processor. 8MB QSPI Flash, STEMMA QT connector, NeoPixel. Boot and reset buttons. Works with CircuitPython and MicroPython. Future-proof design with latest RP silicon.

Low-noise microphone amplifier with integrated 20-20kHz electret microphone. Selectable 25x to 125x gain via trimmer pot. Excellent power supply noise rejection. Rail-to-rail output for maximum ADC range. Perfect for voice changers and audio-reactive projects.

# Nano

## Overview
The Nano is a compact and versatile board that surprisingly handles many of my existing projects designed for the UNO. Its small size makes it a great choice for projects where space is at a premium.

## Design Insights
This was the first board in this repository where I had to use a fully surface-mount USB-C connector instead of a through-hole variant. The original Nano also utilizes a surface-mount USB connector, as a through-hole option would interfere with routing and placement on the bottom layer.

While integrating the larger footprint of the USB-C connector, I had to adjust the silkscreen labels near the connector, but I ensured that all the necessary information remained clear and accessible.

# UNO R4 WiFi

As soon as I saw the 96 LED array on this board, I knew that I would be in for some work, and of all the boards in this repository, this is the only one that I am not confident would pass a fabricator's specifications. I will highlight the parts of this board that I think may be problematic below.

# EurorackModules Open-source eurorack synthesizer modules. All our schematics and pcbs are developed with [KiCad.](http://kicad-pcb.org/) ## 1U modules These are simple (passive) utility modules, designed to fit the Intellijel 1U spec. They are often smaller (6 or 8HP) so you can use them to fill gaps in your system. Except for the Multibus... that one takes up an entire row. | | Module | Description | | --- | :----- | :---------- | || [LPG](1Utilities/1U_LPG) | A simple passive low-pass gate with -6dB slope in a small 1U package. | || [Mute](1Utilities/1U_Mute) | A signal mute (momentary and latching) in a convenient 1U package.| || [Mult](1Utilities/1U_Mult) | Dead simple passive multi.
